message: So, I had a bit of a comedy of errors during the last blackout—think candlelight dinner gone wrong when I realized I had no matches! 😅 That’s when I found this handy resource on how to prepare for power outages. Whether it’s stocking up on batteries or having a few flashlight strategies, being ready can turn a potential panic into a cozy night in. Have you ever been caught unprepared during a blackout?
